research.title: Certify, Then Select: Viability-Aware Runtime Steering of Frozen Diffusion Policies
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Diffusion policies, which generate short action sequences by denoising random noise, are a leading way to learn robot skills from demonstrations. Once deployed, they meet constraints the demonstrations never contained, and retraining for each is impractical. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Distance-Certified Safe Control in Unknown Environments via Spatio-Temporal Composition of Gaussian Processes
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper, we propose a distance-certified safety control framework for unknown and dynamic environments. The proposed strategy relies on a spatio-temporal composition of Gaussian Process (GP) barriers from environment point clouds. A point-cloud-dependent covariance kernel. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Distilling Safety Filters for Filter-free Multi-agent RL
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can teach robot teams to navigate shared spaces, but trial and error causes collisions that real robots cannot afford. Control barrier function (CBF) safety filters prevent these collisions by correcting unsafe actions, yet. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Enforcing Ellipsoidal Constraints in Neural Networks with a Polynomial Safety Layer
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Often the output of a learned mapping must satisfy prescribed constraints. research.title: Optimal Coordination of Multiple Ancillary Service Provisions in Active Distribution Networks
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: We propose a multi-rate model predictive control (MPC) framework for coordinating primary frequency control (PFC), automatic generation control (AGC), and voltage control (VC) in active distribution networks. The framework allocates distributed energy resource (DER) flexibility among. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Reliable Conditioned Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability via Subsolution Learning on Exact Local Windows
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability computes the maximal safe set and a safety filter for a given obstacle configuration, but it must be re-solved whenever the obstacles change, which a deployed robot cannot afford. Learning a single value. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Representing Differential Inclusions as Monads: A Framework for Compositional Controller Synthesis
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Sequential composition of safety-certified controllers for hybrid and non-smooth robotic systems is well studied piecewise. Yet no existing framework reduces this question to a single algebraic condition. We construct a \emph{trajectory monad} for Filippov-regular differential inclusions. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
